carry: Lean flow study alignment (STUDY K17), binding on the build. The flow groups add work the approved design's beat and ledger must own, and they land first, so build them in: (0) The beat and every job it runs are detached processes, never an agent loop: in the live run of 2026-10-21, agent-based relay and tick loops ended their turns twice and had to be re-armed. beatd.py runs under daemonize.py and an operating-system supervisor that restarts it (launchd on the orchestrator's Mac, a user systemd unit elsewhere); an agent only reads beatd status and the journal, and never hosts a job. Jobs run concurrently: one job's run never delays another job's schedule, so a long handoff update (9 min observed on 2026-10-21) never leaves the tick board stale; the tick reads independently of the relay, as R10-TICK-RELAY-DECOUPLE (#2549) already does for tick_loop.sh. The handoff job honours R10-FLOW-RELAY-HOLD's hold file. (1) beatd.jobs.json gains two jobs: heartbeat (R10-FLOW-ANDON's job script; interval 300 s, timeout 60 s; its ref message carries beatd status, so a timed-out job alerts the owner, not only a dead host) and pitch (R10-FLOW-AUTOTRAIN's job script; on the hour or when the previous train ends; it only launches a detached train and reads the train-stop obligation, never waits on CI). (2) The ledger gains one event kind, postmerge-owed (producer: R10-FLOW-POSTMERGE's after-merge step; closer: that step's later success or an orchestrator disposition), because the design refuses an OWED shape with no ledger kind. (3) The handoff job carries R10-FLOW-BODY-ONLY's body-only path unchanged and writes a disposition for the handoff-body ref it applies; it also does not move any pull request head while that pull request has a live reviewer in workers.json, which generalises R10-FLOW-ROSTER-FREEZE's predicate from the roster pull request to every head (fixer.md's freeze, made mechanical). (4) The seats job reads the dispatch records R10-FLOW-DISPATCH writes through bus.sh dispatch, which also gives the folded dispatch reason the round-3 review's N11-R found has no backing state. (4b) The ledger's verdict-unposted obligation closes only on a read-back: the posted pull request comment fetched and its first line matching the verdict and head, as comment-readback.md requires; a relayed claim that a verdict was posted is not a close (revision 8, observed live). (5) Is-main-red has one owner, the classifier #2570 and R10-FLOW-MAIN-GATE share; the tick and the sweep do not grow a third. (6) The plan page: if R10-PLAN-ARTIFACT (#2558) merges first, part (3) extracts plan_model() from its code rather than building a second page, keeps the UNAVAILABLE page and the five mutation fixtures, and renders R10-FLOW-BOARD's flow section from the same model. (7) Inventory row M43 is stale: pr_cap.py gates dispatch, not opening, since #2525.
